Justice Ujjal Bhuyan Warns of Shrinking Democratic Space in India

Justice Ujjal Bhuyan stated that the democratic space in India is shrinking due to curbs on dissent. He made this claim during a lecture at NLIU Bhopal, where he was scheduled to deliver the 4th Justice G.P. Singh Memorial Lecture. The Wire reported that Bhuyan warned of the dangers of suppressing dissenting voices. LiveLaw noted that Bhuyan's lecture focused on the importance of democratic values. The Indian Express highlighted Bhuyan's statement about consuming chicken biryani being no offense, but emphasizing the essence of democracy in dissent.
